purpose: Continuously detect, verify, rank, and brief material public developments across every technology domain while preserving source provenance, prices and availability where reported, and rejecting stale, duplicated, unsupported, promotional, or operationally unsafe material.
operatingState: G3 PASS — ready for bounded public-source shadow qualification

components.name: Intelligence Control Plane
components.responsibility: Own scheduled and event-driven run identity, bounded retries, cancellation, typed routing, terminal states, and authority accounting.

components.name: Source Registry
components.responsibility: Store approved sources, ownership, domain coverage, reliability tier, retrieval method, review cadence, and active or paused state.

components.name: Public Source Acquisition
components.responsibility: Collect only approved public pages, feeds, transcripts, papers, filings, registries, and announcements under rate and freshness limits.

components.name: Media And Transcript Extraction
components.responsibility: Extract attributable text and metadata from supported public video, audio, document, and web inputs without inventing unavailable content.

components.name: Technology Event Normalizer
components.responsibility: Normalize each signal into a source-attributed event with actor, action, object, place, time, price, availability, evidence tier, and claim mode.

components.name: Duplicate And Story Clusterer
components.responsibility: Collapse repeated coverage and updates into canonical story clusters while preserving every source and material delta.

components.name: Universal Technology Taxonomy Router
components.responsibility: Route events across the governed technology taxonomy and retain an emerging-or-unclassified escape hatch for genuinely new fields.

components.name: Provenance Evidence Store
components.responsibility: Retain immutable source snapshots, hashes, timestamps, extraction metadata, claim links, corrections, and retention status.

components.name: General Technology Systems Analyst
components.responsibility: Interpret verified AI, computing, semiconductors, robotics, autonomy, energy, space, manufacturing, materials, mobility, telecom, quantum, cybersecurity, climate, agriculture, construction, and consumer technology evidence.

components.name: Medicine And Life Sciences Analyst
components.responsibility: Interpret verified medicine, medical-device, biotech, genomics, clinical-trial, regulatory, and health-system evidence without giving medical advice or upgrading preliminary claims.

components.name: Defense And Dual Use Technology Analyst
components.responsibility: Interpret public evidence about battlefield, drone, electronic-warfare, counter-drone, logistics, sensing, autonomy, and dual-use capabilities without producing tactical operational instructions.

components.name: Cross Domain Synthesis Analyst
components.responsibility: Identify connections, second-order effects, competing approaches, adoption constraints, and changes since the prior verified state across specialist analyses.

components.name: Claim And Price Verification Desk
components.responsibility: Check claim mode, source independence, primary evidence, dates, availability, currency, geography, quantity, and uncertainty; distinguish a person's statement from an externally verified fact.

components.name: Novelty And Significance Scorer
components.responsibility: Score novelty, consequence, evidence confidence, immediacy, adoption readiness, price relevance, and owner-defined watch priority using deterministic rules.

components.name: Technology Coverage Auditor
components.responsibility: Measure source and event coverage across every governed domain, flag blind spots and silent-source failures, and preserve an unclassified queue.

components.name: Independent Intelligence Quality Gate
components.responsibility: Reject unsupported success claims, promotional noise, duplicates without material delta, stale evidence, missing provenance, unsafe operational detail, false price precision, and incomplete domain coverage accounting.

components.name: Evidence Linked Brief Renderer
components.responsibility: Render scannable daily and on-demand briefs with what happened, who built what where, cost and availability when known, why it matters, confidence, caveats, and direct evidence links.

components.name: Urgent Technology Alert Gate
components.responsibility: Recommend immediate notification only for high-significance, sufficiently verified, genuinely new developments; otherwise route to daily brief or watchlist.

components.name: Run 009 Publishing Adapter
components.responsibility: Prepare a typed publication package for PUB-ENG-009 without claiming downstream acceptance, publishing, or delivery.

components.name: Owner Activation And Notification Approval
components.responsibility: Approve connectors, recipients, cadence, spend ceiling, and any future notification or publication authority before activation.

components.name: Run 008 Operations Adapter
components.responsibility: Prepare terminal receipts, dead-letter items, source-health signals, and typed ops_handoff_v1 for OPS-CORE-008 without claiming downstream execution.

g4.requiredEvidence: One bounded public-source shadow run with concrete source URLs, source-health evidence, real model outputs, measured cost, independent QA, no delivery, and zero unsupported claims.
